title: Visit Array Positions to Maximize Score
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and a positive integer x, start at index 0 and move to any subsequent index to accumulate scores.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and a positive integer x, start at index 0 and move to any subsequent index to accumulate scores. If moving from an index i to j results in a score change due to differing parities, subtract x from the total score. The goal is to maximize the total score. Initially, you have nums[0] points.
constraints: Choose a subsequence that must include nums[0].
Its score is the sum of chosen values minus x whenever consecutive chosen values have different parity.
hints: Keep the best score ending in an even and odd chosen value.
For each value, either extend the same parity freely or switch from the other parity and pay x.
Initialize only the parity of nums[0], then update the current value’s parity state.
These two states retain exactly the only history—last parity—that affects every future choice.
editorial: These two states retain exactly the only history—last parity—that affects every future choice.

tests.explanation: An optimal parity-aware subsequence has score thirteen.
Taking every even value pays no switching penalty and scores twelve.
